title: GLY 101 - Introduction to Geology
topics: Rock types and the rock cycle

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Extrusive rock?
o: the tendency of a mineral to break along flat planes of weak bonding
the thick layer of hot silicate rock between the crust and the core
igneous rock that cooled quickly at the surface, giving small crystals
the study of the earth, its materials, its history and the processes shaping it
items.s: Extrusive rock: igneous rock that cooled quickly at the surface, giving small crystals. The other options describe Geology, Cleavage, Mantle.

items.q: The statement “a vibration that travels through the earth after an earthquake” describes which of the following?

P wave
Mohorovicic discontinuity
Seismic wave
items.s: Seismic wave is a vibration that travels through the earth after an earthquake.

items.q: The statement “a plate margin where two plates move apart and new crust forms” describes which of the following?

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines Geology.

the principle that processes working today also shaped the earth in the past
the branch that studies the occurrence and exploitation of useful mineral deposits
the study of the earth, its materials, its history and the processes shaping it
items.s: Geology: the study of the earth, its materials, its history and the processes shaping it. The other options describe Uniformitarianism, Economic geology, Divergent boundary.

items.q: The statement “a ranking of ten reference minerals by increasing scratch hardness” describes which of the following?

items.s: Geology: the study of the earth, its materials, its history and the processes shaping it. The other options describe Clastic rock, Regional metamorphism, Trace fossil.
